// Fixture: markup attributes are not text, but the attributes that the player reads are.
export function Panel(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <section className="nobody-panel everyone-panel" data-kind="nobody-kind-value" id="nobody-id-value">
      <button title="Nobody can click this button" aria-label="Everyone can read this">Go</button>
      <input placeholder="Nobody types here" type="nobody-type-value" />
    </section>
  )
}
